name: pro-management
title: Pro Management
description: Quickly manage and open local project directories with 1-click IDE launch, pin, and favorite support
author: louis

preferences.name: scanDirectories
preferences.title: Scan Directories
preferences.description: Comma-separated list of root directories to scan recursively for Git repositories (max depth 4). Example: ~/project,~/work

preferences.name: customCommands
preferences.title: Custom Commands
preferences.description: Append custom IDE/tool commands in format name:template, comma-separated. Example: code:code {path},cursor:cursor {path}

preferences.name: globalSkillDirectory
preferences.title: Global Skill Directory
preferences.description: Global canonical AI skill repository (aligned with vercel-labs/skills standard). Automatically symlinked to non-universal agents like Claude Code.

preferences.name: backupDirectory
preferences.title: Skill Backup Directory
preferences.description: Skill backup directory. If set, a copy of all skills will be automatically synchronized here for version control or disaster recovery.

commands.name: search-projects
commands.title: Search Projects
commands.subtitle: Pro Management
commands.description: Search and manage local projects, open them instantly with IDE or tools

commands.name: manage-skills
commands.title: Manage Skills
commands.subtitle: Pro Management
commands.description: Unified management of automation skills for multiple AI Agents (Claude Code/Antigravity) with quick lookup and execution
